messages:
laura: FYI MediCore (HIPAA + SOC2 + FedRAMP-style) sent a long list: per-event signing, export encryption, redaction policy per field, and RBAC scoping for audit views.

 tom: Do we have existing per-event signature capability? We do per-bundle HMAC today right?

 rachel: Correct. Current export flow signs bundles with Redwood-managed CMK HMAC; webhooks use an X-Signature header. No per-event signing in prod.

 anna-ops: MediCore insists on per-event verification for replay audits. They want an index mapping event_id->offset and a CSV for auditors.

 legal-sam: Contractwise we can offer: (a) Redwood-managed signing with attestations, (b) customer-provided CMK with cross-account calls. Need SOW for BYOK and KMS access patterns.

 infra-bot: Note: cross-account KMS implies IAM roles and additional telemetry. We'll need to capture GenerateMac logs for key lineage.

 sec-bot: Open a vuln ticket for any parser that ingests uploaded bundles. Avoid eval/unsafe regex; validate JSON schema strictly.

 miguel: For redaction, propose embedding a redact_manifest.json in the bundle listing fields removed and the redaction rule id. Also include a redaction_hash so auditors can verify redaction policy applied.

 laura: Proposed schema changes (minor bump v1.6):
 - event.metadata.redaction_ids: ["uuid"]
 - event.metadata.sensitive_tags: ["phi","pci"]
 - bundle.sidecars: {"index.csv","redact_manifest.json","signatures/"}
 - event.headers.signature_v: "hmac-sha256"

 rachel: Backwards compatibility: all new fields optional. Publish deprecation/migration docs and release a feature flag so tenants opt-in.

 tom: Verification tooling: small CLI and a lambda-based verifier that auditors can run. Example CLI:
 ```
 verify-audit --bundle medicore-2026-03-31.tar.gz \
   --sig signatures/medicore-2026-03-31.sig \
   --pubkey medi-core.pub \
   --check-redaction-policy redact_manifest.json
 ```
 It should verify signature, check index integrity, and run a PHI-scan on non-redacted fields (failing loudly).

 miguel: Decision on per-event vs per-bundle: per-bundle adequate for export use-case. For webhook/live stream, HMAC per message required. If customer insists per-event HMAC in bundle, cost+storage increases.

 laura: Ops SLA ask: customer wants "daily bundle available in their bucket within 12h" and 99.9% uptime. Ops suggests 24h and 99.5% initially. Need legal to agree on dispute windows.

 legal-sam: I'll draft addendum options: 12h SLA with penalty, or 24h with credits. Also include key-rotation attestations and retention terms (we're ok with configurable retention up to 7 years).

 anna-ops: Migration plan: rollout behind tenant feature flag. Start with Redwood-managed keys + bundle signing, then pilot BYOK for a small customer cohort.

 sec-bot: Reminder: logging of signing operations and rotation events must be included in internal audit trail. Retain signing operation logs for at least 2 years.

 laura: Action items:
 - tom: spec v1.6 schema PR with examples and migration notes (ETA Tue)
 - miguel: redact_manifest & index.csv generator prototype + PHI-scan tool (ETA Wed)
 - anna-ops: SLA feasibility and draft ops runbook (ETA Thu)
 - legal-sam: contract addendum drafts for BYOK and SLA options (ETA Fri)
 - laura: open vuln ticket for bundle-parsers and coordinate with sec (now)

 rachel: I'll add unit tests for verification CLI and ensure it doesn't execute any untrusted code.

 laura: Thanks all. I'll send MediCore a summary tomorrow and propose a pilot. Ping here if priorities change.

 infra-bot: ticket created: AUDIT-5274 audit-bundle-parser-hardening

 sec-bot: priority: high
